behavioral-psychology.md.summary: Behavior shaped by environmental consequences. Classical conditioning pairs stimuli. Operant conditioning uses reinforcement and punishment. PTSD modeled as conditioned fear response (Pavlov) with reinforced avoidance (Skinner).

cognitive-psychology.md.summary: Studies mental processes: perception, memory, thinking, decision-making. Mind as information processor. Hallucinations as top-down perceptual errors; PTSD cognitive distortions (Beck).

key-concepts.md.summary: Core concepts bridging behavioral and cognitive approaches. PTSD integrates conditioning and cognitive schemas.

key-researchers.md.summary: Historical figures who shaped the fields. Added Beck and Ellis for cognitive therapy in PTSD.

ptsd-specific.md.summary: PTSD as conditioned fear (Pavlov), reinforced avoidance (Skinner), cognitive distortions (Beck). Hallucinations common and trauma-linked. Hypertension via sympathetic activation. First-line: PE, CPT, EMDR.
